title: Uint64 Benchmark Stability
objective: Make the packed UInt64 structural performance regression gate statistically robust under parallel unit-tier load while preserving detection of nonlinear traversal regressions

handoff.summary: Replaced sub-millisecond minimum-of-three timing with warmed, alternating paired batches and median per-call measurements. The original absolute and 4x scaling gates remain, while 24 test processes completed successfully under eight-way concurrent load.
risks: This remains a wall-clock performance smoke test, so catastrophic machine-wide contention can still delay it; batching makes ordinary unit-tier concurrency statistically robust.
next_steps: Keep detailed cross-host performance history in benchmark infrastructure rather than tightening this unit-tier smoke gate around one machine.
